# PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Haderslev)

PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Haderslev) is a local psychiatric unit named in the reporting tables of the ADHD-databasen 2024 report, in the context of Indikator 10 — a measure of the share of adult treatment courses in which a patient's need for social support was assessed within 120 days of treatment start [^src1]. The unit reported a fulfillment rate of 28% (with a confidence interval of 20-39%), based on 27 out of 95 treatment courses meeting the criterion [^src1]. This is well below the national quality target of 90% [^src1], and it also falls under the broader national result of 37% and the regional range of 14-52% reported for this indicator across the country [^src1].

This is the first time Indikator 10 has been reported in the ADHD database, and the wider dataset shows substantial gaps in meeting the quality goal both nationally and regionally, prompting the steering group behind the report to discuss possible causes — including registration practices and the underlying data from child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals — and to commit to improving registration practice going forward [^src1].

The unit appears a second time in the same report in what is presented as a distinct results table, showing 47 out of 95 treatment courses meeting the relevant criterion, a fulfillment rate of 49% (confidence interval 39-60%) [^src2]. The report does not specify further detail distinguishing what this second figure measures relative to the first beyond the page context in which it appears.

No relationships or additional claims involving PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Haderslev) are documented in the corpus beyond these two data points.
